entities.name: Soramaro
entities.description: Kami of Kamigawa who was once a half-human, half-soratami wizard.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which Soramaro's descendants were active.

events.summary: Soramaro was so revered by his students that his spirit became a kami.
events.quote: He studied the ways of magic and was so revered by his students that his spirit became a kami .
